label: vBucket takeover
type: the rebalance-time handoff of a vBucket's active role from one node to another, tracked over DCP (current) or TAP (legacy, pre-5.0). Monitored via cbstats dcp-vbtakeover/tap-vbtakeover, used internally by the cluster manager (ns_server).
evidence: This command is used by cluster manager (ns_server) to track the progress of rebalance using DCP.
state | The stream state (pending, backfilling, in-memory, takeover-send, takeover-wait, or dead)
note: cbstats tap-vbtakeover is the legacy path for the same handoff concept over the now-removed TAP protocol (see protocol:tap, retainedForLegacyCompatibility).
relates_to_competency_question: How does an administrator track a vBucket's active-role handoff during rebalance?
